dedupe_keys.name: a high resolution large scale dataset for building segmentation from aerial imagery in northeastern italy

description: A high-resolution large-scale dataset for building segmentation from aerial imagery in northeastern Italy is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Claudio Rota et al. Accurate building segmentation from high-resolution aerial imagery is used in applications in remote sensing, urban planning, and disaster management. While AI-based methods enable segmentation of building footprints, their development is often limited by the scarce availability of large-scale, geographically diverse datasets with reliable pixel-level annotations. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2025. Formats: CSV, GeoTIFF, TXT, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Mendeley Data and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
